Every Linux distribution is skein-regist.why: Made up for this record: the relation 'is skein-registered with' is invented; Linux distributions and the Linux Foundation are real. Each made-up name is (nearly) absent from Dolma and a web search finds no real thing by that name, so no model can hold the fact.

sources.note: Exact-phrase web search: no software, product, company, person or place by this name; only unrelated near-spellings.

Debian is a Linux distribution..why: Stated in the Debian article and everywhere Linux distributions are listed.

sources.quote: It is the second-oldest Linux distribution still being developed

Ubuntu is based on Debian..why: The first sentence of the Ubuntu article.

sources.quote: is a Linux distribution based on Debian and composed primarily of free and open-source software

Arch Linux is a Linux distribution..why: Arch Linux is listed and described as a Linux distribution everywhere; its article's short description is "Rolling release Linux distribution".

notes: Fictional relation TBox insert: a real class (Linux distributions) given a made-up relation to a real organisation. Well-known members (Debian, Arch Linux) are determinate here, unlike a replace TBox: no stored fact about skein-registration competes with the rule. One query names a new member (Quillmere, invented, count 0). The inverse is stated in the prompt. A query on the Linux Foundation's headquarters was dropped: the article's infobox gives a Wilmington, Delaware mailing address, not a clear city.
